draft.body:
Siloed credit is a liquidation trap. On Gearbox, one dip liquidates you—even if your other sandbox is flush.

Vanna cross-margins your risk. One account, one unified safety buffer. Our 1.1x floor protects against oracle lag.

Leverage is easy. Keeping your positions alive is the hard part.

Testnet only.
